title: Core existence of affine transition limit
statement: For every directed nonempty inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, there exists a cone which is a limit.

proof.text: Choose a stage i0 and the upper-tail preorder J = {j | i0 ≤ j}. J is directed and nonempty. Its inclusion into I is final: every i has a common upper bound with i0, and parallel arrows agree because I is a preorder. Equivalently its opposite inclusion is initial. Lift the restricted diagram to schemes affine over S = D(i0), with structure maps the transitions to i0. Functoriality follows from D.map_comp and uniqueness of preorder arrows.

Apply affine_morphism_relative_spec S to obtain the anti-equivalence E. Send the lifted diagram F to the directed algebra diagram F.rightOp ⋙ E.functor. Apply quasiCoherentAlgebra_colimit to its underlying algebra-sheaf diagram. Its quasi-coherent colimit vertex creates a colimit in the full quasi-coherent subcategory (Mathlib createsColimitFullSubcategoryInclusion'). Transfer the colimit through E, then take opposites, obtaining HasLimit F. This is the proved private helper hasLimit_affineOver.

Choose the limit cone of F. Apply isLimit_affineOver_inclusion to obtain its limit property in Over S. The index category is cofiltered and thus connected, so Mathlib Over.forget S preserves this limit. The resulting diagram is definitionally the upper-tail restriction of D. Mathlib Functor.Initial.hasLimit_of_comp transfers existence along the initial inclusion. Choose the resulting cone and its limit proof.
